plan.notes: Source: official CACC 'LPN to Associate Degree Nursing (RN) Mobility Program' information sheet (cacc.edu), 'Information revised 1/31/2025'. Degree Earned: Associate in Applied Science; Length: '3 Semesters (51 semester hours of which 20 semester hours of prerequisite course work are required for admission)'. total_credits is the sequenced sum only (10+11+10 = 31); the 20 prerequisite hours required for admission are not sequenced in the source. Titles are the source labels verbatim. '* NUR 209 is required unless the applicant graduated from the Alabama Community College System One Plus One Curriculum within 1 year of the current nursing application deadline.' '** May be taken prior to entering the nursing program or taken concurrently with nursing courses as outlined above' (BIO 220, Humanities Elective). The source prints no catalog year; catalog_year stamped with retrieval year (2026) and documented here. Program cross-validated in the official 2026-2027 CACC catalog program listing ('LPN to RN Mobility', 41-51 hours).
